package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/robertkrimen/otto"
)

// FilterItems filters a slice of map[string]interface{} items using a JavaScript condition script.
// The script is evaluated once per item, with the current item exposed as the variable 'item'.
// The script should evaluate to a truthy or falsy value; items for which the script is truthy are included.
// The function prevents mutation of the original items by evaluating on a deep copy (via JSON round‑trip).
func FilterItems(conditionScript string, items []map[string]interface{}) ([]map[string]interface{}, error) {
	vm := otto.New()
	// Compile the condition script once. It will be executed per item with 'item' set.
	script, err := vm.Compile("", conditionScript)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var result []map[string]interface{}

	for _, originalItem := range items {
		// Deep copy the item via JSON to guarantee isolation and prevent mutation of the original.
		itemCopy, err := deepCopyMap(originalItem)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		// Expose the current item as the variable 'item' in the JavaScript environment.
		if err := vm.Set("item", itemCopy); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		// Run the condition script.
		value, err := vm.Run(script)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		boolResult, err := value.ToBoolean()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		if boolResult {
			result = append(result, originalItem)
		}
	}

	return result, nil
}

// deepCopyMap creates a deep copy of a map[string]interface{} by JSON round‑trip.
// This handles any JSON‑compatible nested types, including slices of any element type.
func deepCopyMap(src map[string]interface{}) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
	// Marshal to JSON
	data, err := json.Marshal(src)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// Unmarshal back into a fresh map
	var dst map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &dst); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return dst, nil
}
